name: Arcadence: The Nostalgic Roguelike
description:
About This Game

Arcadence is a roguelike strategy game inspired by B**tro, where you build combinations of symbols, modifiers, and… questionable decisions.

It all comes down to how well you can turn randomness into strategy. Collect mods, symbols, and effects, discover unexpected synergies, break the balance, and watch the game slowly turn into something even we didn't expect it to become. In theory, it might even crash. (It won't. We checked.)

Every run offers a new set of possibilities. Every decision could become part of a brilliant build. Or completely useless nonsense. You usually find out which one it is a little too late.

Key Features

Symbols

Collect symbols with unique effects and create chains of interactions. The better you understand what's happening, the more likely you are to pretend it was all part of the plan.

And, of course… stack some modifiers on top. Because apparently one effect is never enough.

C-c-combos

The game randomly generates symbol positions for creating combos. So everything is in the hands of RANDOMNESS.

Which is, of course, completely unfair. What kind of strategy can you possibly have here? A RANDOM ONE!

Every run opens up new ways to make the system work for you.

Mods

Mods introduce new conditions and mechanics, enhance your symbols, and let you create completely insane combinations. Sometimes so insane that you start to suspect the developers simply forgot to add a limit.

Combine. Experiment. Break the game. If you find a combination that's too powerful — don't tell anyone.

Cheats

   

Cheats are special tactical tools that let you temporarily break the rules of the game. Because if the rules get in the way of your strategy, obviously, the rules are the problem.

Use them when things are going badly, when things are going suspiciously well, or when you simply want to see what happens.

Bosses

Found the perfect strategy? Great. The boss found it too.

Each boss changes the rules of the game and forces you to find a new way to win. Or at least come up with a convincing explanation for why your previous build was bad.

References

Have you noticed how many references and Easter eggs are hidden here? So have we. Some of them were even intentional.

Luck Control

Randomness matters here. But you don't have to completely surrender to it. Increase your multipliers, raise the risk, play aggressively, or build a reliable strategy. You decide how far you're willing to go for one more ridiculously big number. And yes, if everything goes horribly wrong — that was part of the strategy.

Arcadence is made for players who enjoy roguelikes, build-crafting, insane synergies, and games where one tiny combination can suddenly turn into a mathematical catastrophe.

Good luck. You'll need it.
short_desc: Arcadence is a roguelike strategy game built around an arcade machine, where you collect symbols, create insane synergies, and turn randomness into huge numbers. Build your strategies, break the balance, and pretend it was all part of the plan.
